resources.string: Scanova keeps your documents on a server you control. Scan the pairing code shown when the server was set up, or enter its details.
Enter the server\'s address. It must use https.
64 characters, printed by the server setup. Leave empty only if your server uses a publicly trusted certificate.
A fingerprint has 64 characters: the digits 0 to 9 and the letters a to f.
The code includes the server\'s certificate fingerprint, so only that server can answer.
The code has no certificate fingerprint. Any server with a public certificate for this address will be trusted.
Only continue if you set up this server or its owner gave you this code. Your password and documents will be sent to it.
Point the camera at the QR code printed by the server setup.
Camera preview for scanning the pairing code
That QR code is not a Scanova pairing code.

Scanova uses the camera to read the pairing code. Nothing is recorded or stored.
